sentences.text: Setiap Minggu pagi, Bayu suka berbelanja barang bekas di pasar loak dekat stasiun.
sentences.en: Every Sunday morning, Bayu likes shopping for secondhand goods at the flea market near the station.
sentences.ko: 매주 일요일 아침 바유는 역 근처 벼룩시장에서 중고 물건 사는 걸 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Seminggu sebelum menikah, Intan sibuk berbelanja oleh-oleh untuk keluarga calon suaminya.
sentences.en: A week before the wedding, Intan was busy shopping for gifts for her future husband's family.
sentences.ko: 결혼 일주일 전에 인탄은 예비 시댁 식구들에게 줄 선물을 사느라 바빴어요.

sentences.text: Bayu menemukan botol parfum antik berbentuk burung di sebuah lapak.
sentences.en: Bayu found an antique bird-shaped perfume bottle at one of the stalls.
sentences.ko: 바유는 한 노점에서 새 모양의 골동품 향수병을 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Aroma parfum melati Intan tercium sampai ke ujung ruangan.
sentences.en: The scent of Intan's jasmine perfume could be smelled all the way to the end of the room.
sentences.ko: 인탄의 재스민 향수 냄새가 방 끝까지 퍼졌어요.

sentences.text: Bayu menyisihkan sebagian tabungan khusus untuk berburu barang antik.
sentences.en: Bayu sets aside part of his savings just for hunting antiques.
sentences.ko: 바유는 골동품 사냥용으로 저축 일부를 따로 떼어 둬요.

sentences.text: Intan dan tunangannya mengumpulkan tabungan selama dua tahun untuk pesta itu.
sentences.en: Intan and her fiancé saved up for two years for the party.
sentences.ko: 인탄과 약혼자는 그 잔치를 위해 2년 동안 돈을 모았어요.

sentences.text: Penjual itu bilang radio tua tersebut senilai gaji sebulan.
sentences.en: The seller said the old radio was worth a month's salary.
sentences.ko: 판매자는 그 낡은 라디오가 한 달 월급만큼 값어치가 있다고 했어요.

sentences.text: Cincin kawin Intan senilai tiga bulan gaji suaminya.
sentences.en: Intan's wedding ring is worth three months of her husband's salary.
sentences.ko: 인탄의 결혼반지는 남편 석 달 월급만큼 값이 나가요.

sentences.text: Mesin tik yang diincar Bayu ternyata sudah terjual sejak pagi.
sentences.en: The typewriter Bayu had his eye on had already been sold that morning.
sentences.ko: 바유가 노리던 타자기는 알고 보니 아침에 이미 팔렸어요.

sentences.text: Sisa kain kebaya Intan dijadikan dompet kecil dan terjual habis di bazar keluarga.

sentences.ko: 인탄의 크바야를 만들고 남은 천으로 작은 지갑을 만들었더니 가족 바자회에서 다 팔렸어요.

sentences.text: Pedagang piringan hitam itu bilang pasokan dari luar kota sedang sedikit.

sentences.ko: 레코드 판매상은 지금 외지에서 들어오는 물량이 적다고 했어요.

sentences.text: Gara-gara hujan, pasokan bunga segar untuk dekorasi pernikahan Intan terlambat datang.
sentences.en: Because of the rain, the supply of fresh flowers for Intan's wedding decorations arrived late.
sentences.ko: 비 때문에 인탄 결혼식 장식용 생화 공급이 늦어졌어요.

sentences.text: Bayu tidak peduli merek, yang penting jaketnya masih bagus.
sentences.en: Bayu doesn't care about the brand; what matters is that the jacket is still in good shape.
sentences.ko: 바유는 상표는 상관없고 재킷 상태만 좋으면 돼요.

sentences.text: Intan memilih sepatu pengantin dari merek lokal yang dibuat dengan tangan.

sentences.ko: 인탄은 손으로 만드는 국내 브랜드의 웨딩 슈즈를 골랐어요.

sentences.text: Ayah Intan memakai simpanan masa pensiunnya untuk menambah biaya pesta.

sentences.text: Bayu memasukkan uang receh ke kantung kecil di pinggangnya.
sentences.en: Bayu put the coins into the small pouch at his waist.
sentences.ko: 바유는 동전을 허리춤의 작은 주머니에 넣었어요.

sentences.text: Intan menyimpan amplop dari tamu di dalam kantung kain yang dijahit ibunya.

sentences.ko: 인탄은 손님들의 봉투를 엄마가 꿰매 준 천 주머니에 넣어 뒀어요.

sentences.text: Bayu berjanji akan melunasi sisa harga lemari itu minggu depan.

sentences.text: Topi bekas yang dibeli Bayu masih dihiasi pita hitam di sekelilingnya.
sentences.en: The secondhand hat Bayu bought is still trimmed with a black ribbon around it.

sentences.text: Dari hasil jual-beli barang bekas, Bayu bisa membiayai kuliahnya sendiri.

sentences.ko: 인탄의 아버지는 손님들 축의금이면 잔치 비용이 본전은 된다고 계산했어요.

sentences.text: Bayu suka mengoleksi kancing kuningan dari seragam zaman dulu.

sentences.text: Gaun pengantin Intan dibeli dari sebuah lelang amal.

sentences.text: Seorang pedagang mencegat Bayu di pintu masuk dan menawarkan jam tangan palsu.
sentences.en: A trader stopped Bayu at the entrance and offered him a fake watch.
sentences.ko: 한 상인이 입구에서 바유를 가로막고 가짜 시계를 권했어요.

sentences.text: Dalam tradisi keluarga Intan, adik-adik mencegat rombongan pengantin pria di depan pintu dan meminta uang tebusan.
sentences.en: In Intan's family tradition, the younger siblings block the groom's party at the door and ask for a ransom.
sentences.ko: 인탄네 집안 전통에서는 동생들이 문 앞에서 신랑 일행을 가로막고 몸값을 요구해요.

sentences.text: Dua anak di pasar berduel dengan pedang kayu yang baru dibeli ayah mereka.
sentences.en: Two kids at the market dueled with wooden swords their father had just bought.
sentences.ko: 시장에서 두 아이가 아빠가 막 사 준 나무칼로 결투를 벌였어요.

sentences.text: Dua penari pencak silat berduel di depan pelaminan untuk menyambut pengantin.
sentences.en: Two pencak silat dancers dueled in front of the dais to welcome the couple.
sentences.ko: 두 명의 펜착 실랏 무용수가 신랑 신부를 맞이하려고 단상 앞에서 겨루기를 했어요.

sentences.text: Bayu menemukan poster film lama tempat aktor favoritnya memerankan seorang bajak laut.
sentences.en: Bayu found an old movie poster in which his favorite actor plays a pirate.
sentences.ko: 바유는 좋아하는 배우가 해적 역을 맡은 옛 영화 포스터를 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Dalam acara hiburan, sepupu Intan memerankan raja dan ratu dalam drama singkat.
sentences.en: During the entertainment, Intan's cousins played a king and queen in a short skit.
sentences.ko: 여흥 시간에 인탄의 사촌들이 짧은 촌극에서 왕과 왕비 역을 맡았어요.

sentences.text: Pedagang buku itu meramalkan harga komik lama akan naik beberapa tahun lagi.
sentences.en: The book dealer predicts that old comics will go up in price in a few years.
sentences.ko: 그 책 장수는 몇 년 뒤면 옛날 만화책 값이 오를 거라고 내다봐요.

sentences.text: Nenek Intan meramalkan hujan tidak akan turun pada hari pernikahan cucunya.
sentences.en: Intan's grandmother predicted that it wouldn't rain on her granddaughter's wedding day.
sentences.ko: 인탄의 할머니는 손녀 결혼식 날에는 비가 오지 않을 거라고 장담했어요.

sentences.text: Pemerintah kota berencana merobohkan bangunan pasar lama dan membangun yang baru.
sentences.en: The city government plans to tear down the old market building and build a new one.
sentences.ko: 시 당국은 옛 시장 건물을 허물고 새로 지을 계획이에요.

sentences.text: Angin kencang sempat merobohkan tenda dekorasi sehari sebelum pernikahan Intan.
sentences.en: A strong wind knocked down the decoration tent the day before Intan's wedding.
sentences.ko: 인탄의 결혼식 전날 강풍에 장식 천막이 쓰러졌어요.
